verdict.rationale: FireHydrant has a dedicated MTTx Analytics page that groups/filters incident metrics by team, service, severity, etc. to show overall health, plus an Alerting Analytics page tracking alert-to-incident conversion and acknowledgment rates, which together give leaders MTTA/MTTR trend and incident-load visibility. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of dedicated on-call health/burnout metrics, no independent/analyst validation of the analytics dashboards' accuracy, and no customer testimonial confirming leaders actually use it to track improvement over time.
